bio: Escape the every day to this charming Hampshire estate, Audleys Wood Hotel, for the ultimate, quintessential dining experience. Nestled within picturesque gardens, the hotel’s striking architecture and impressive interiors create the perfect backdrop to indulge in Afternoon Tea.  Afternoon Tea at Audleys Wood Hotel is served in the Conservatory with beautiful views over the gardens and grounds. In warmer months, you can also enjoy Afternoon Tea alfresco. This elegant yet relaxed setting makes it the perfect spot to unwind and indulge in this British tradition.  Enjoy the age-old tradition of a traditional Afternoon Tea including an array of savoury treats, scones, and sweet pastries, along with a wide selection of loose-leaf teas. The talented pastry chefs prepare the scones and cakes freshly each day. The menu is refreshed regularly to celebrate various occasions and celebrations throughout the year.  Audleys Wood Hotel are able to cater to a wide range of dietary requirements including gluten-free, vegan, and special children's Afternoon Tea options. As the crowning touch, upgrade your traditional experience with a glass of Champagne or Prosecco for the height of luxury.  The hotel is located south of Basingstoke, just 2 miles away from Basingstoke train station.
